name: Umbundu
family: Niger-Congo, Atlantic-Congo, Volta-Congo, Benue-Congo, Bantoid, Southern, Narrow Bantu, Central, R, South Mbundu
notes: Umbundu orthography uses the tilde for nasal vowels and the nasal consonant ñ. Precomposed characters with tilde (ã, ẽ, ĩ, õ, ũ, ñ) are decomposed by the engine and handled via the diacritics mapping. Digraphs mb, nd, ng, nj represent prenasalized consonants.
source: Drafted by gemini-3.1-pro-preview from the AfriSpeech/africa-corpus umb corpus (2942 sentences); not reviewed by a speaker.
